review: Candidate shared-plan status metadata: independent visual review part 2

conclusion: No visual blocker found in the changed collection metadata. The status and complete Europe/Berlin remain below possible dates; title and location wrap without collision in the supplied images. Existing fixed-time and invitation/published presentation remains distinct.
limits: Visual review covers only the 20 supplied candidate captures, not every page, locale, system font size, or device.
Full-page captures include viewport-fixed action or submitted-status bars over the content at the capture position; they do not prove all content is simultaneously visible.
Some narrow invitation timetable captures show a bounded internally scrollable view; the full cross-day endpoint is readable in the summary, but every timetable segment is not simultaneously visible.
No browser interaction, deployment, phone operation, repository edit, or independent API/Calendar integrity verification was performed for this review.
